reason: Machine lens: all opcodes real on the 65SC12 (BRA as before; nothing new). Layout checked in build/strykers.lst: old BNE &9314 (D0 03), BRA &9317, .scrolled &9319 LDX #2 / &931B JSR buffer_to_view / &931E LDX back / &9320 JSR view_to_buffer / &9323 LDA buf_lives,X. Recount: view_to_buffer JSR 6 + 8x(LDA zp 3 + STA abs,X 5) + RTS 6 = 76, always saved; LDX #2 2 + JSR 6 + 8x(LDA abs,X 4 + STA zp 3) + RTS 6 = 70 more saved when pending_n=0: 146 a pass with no scroll, 76 with one or two; the claimed 118 is the measured mix (about 60% no-scroll passes). Bytes: -3 + SKIP 3 = 0.
